description: Analyze React application bundle size to identify optimization opportunities. Task: (1) Open integrated terminal with Ctrl+` (2) Install bundle analysis tool using npm: 'npm install --save-dev webpack-bundle-analyzer' or 'npm install --save-dev source-map-explorer' (3) Run bundle analysis on the existing build in dist/ directory - for webpack-bundle-analyzer use 'npx webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/stats.json', for source-map-explorer use 'npx source-map-explorer dist/*.js' (4) Review the analysis output to identify largest dependencies (5) Create a markdown file named 'BUNDLE_ANALYSIS.md' in the project root (/home/ga/workspace/react-app/) (6) Document at least 3 specific dependency names with their size information (7) Include quantitative data such as sizes in KB or MB, or percentages (8) Provide at least one actionable optimization recommendation such as replacing libraries, using tree-shaking, code-splitting, or lazy-loading. The workspace is located at /home/ga/workspace/react-app/ and contains a package.json with dependencies including lodash, moment, chart.js, and others. A production build with stats.json already exists in the dist/ directory.
